dedupe_keys.name: 2024 noto peninsula earthquake building damage visual assesment

description: Tohoku University and Fuji Tokoha University publish a visual building-damage assessment for the 2024 Noto Peninsula earthquake. The version 2.5 GeoPackage contains 140,208 building footprints, using WGS84 coordinates and multipolygon geometries. Attributes include original and validated damage classes, municipality, assessment confidence, source identifiers and flags for fire, slope failure and tsunami inundation. A Modified Mercalli Intensity value is inherited from the USGS layer. The resource is openly available and free under CC-BY-4.0. A limitation is that damage classes depend on image coverage and visual interpretation; confidence and validation fields should be used when fitting loss relationships. The repository’s DOI field points to an ESSD preprint, so this draft identifies the data through its Zenodo record URL, not assigning that paper DOI to the dataset. It could calibrate or assess building-loss simulations under interacting hazards. It complements data-noto-2024-shiromaru-damage-reconnaissance, which records a separate, local field-survey collection.
